title: Harmonic Australian Flaxseed Pancakes
description: A kid-friendly Australian dish featuring flaxseed, these pancakes are jammy and springy, and made with ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients, using a namul-blanch-season method.

ingredients.name: egg replacement
ingredients.notes: such as flax or chia egg

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the ground flaxseed, all-purpose flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the non-dairy milk, egg replacement, and melted coconut oil.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and grease with a small amount of coconut oil.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter onto the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface.
Flip the pancakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Repeat with the remaining batter, adjusting the heat as needed to prevent burning.
Serve the pancakes warm with a dollop of jam on top and enjoy.
To make the namul-blanch-season method, blanch the pancakes in boiling water for 30 seconds, then season with a pinch of salt and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice.
Let the pancakes cool completely on a wire rack before serving.
